mapper.update: INSERT INTO major_shareholder (merge_key, name_major_stakeholders, shareholding_ratio) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{nameMajorShareholders}, #{shareholdingRatio}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO finance_shareholder (company_id, finance_id, major_shareholder_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{financeId}, #{majorShareholderId}, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid) ON CONFLICT (company_id, finance_id, major_shareholder_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE finance_shareholder SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE deleted = false AND company_id = #{companyId} AND finance_id = #{financeId} AND sync_id != #{syncId}::uuid

UPDATE finance_shareholder fs SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company_finance cf WHERE fs.finance_id = cf.finance_id AND fs.company_id = #{companyId} AND cf.company_id = #{companyId} AND cf.deleted = true AND fs.deleted = false
